intro: Muren Stormpike is an introductory quest for developing Alliance warriors, given once a recruit proves their basic mettle in Dun Morogh. Directed by Granis Swiftaxe in Kharanos, the young fighter travels into the mountain city of Ironforge to seek formal instruction in martial discipline. Meeting Muren marks the beginning of deeper training in tactical stances and dwarven military traditions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, warrior! You show a lot of promise, but you still need to learn some tricks and Muren Stormpike is just the dwarf to teach you.
You can find Muren at the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward of Ironforge. Talk to him when you're ready to learn what it is to be a warrior.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend. I heard the warriors of Dun Morogh bouncing your name around. I hope you haven't spent all your time in the breweries!
